name: Mermaid CLI
one_liner: Command-line interface for generating Mermaid diagrams as SVG/PNG/PDF files

evidence.snippet: This is a command-line interface (CLI) for [mermaid](https://mermaid.js.org/).
Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and fill in your API key
A [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/specification) server providing tools for validating and rendering [Mermaid](https://mermaid.js.org/) diagrams.

notes: Mermaid CLI is an open‑source command‑line tool with a Node.js API; it does not expose a REST or GraphQL endpoint, requires no authentication, and has no pricing or access restrictions.
